summary: The proof is mathematically correct and complete. The finite first moment and interior position of the true weighted mean justify the translation and all positive normalizations. Both log-concavity envelopes are valid, including finite support endpoints, and the mass-preserving left comparison and right-tail integration yield inequality (2) with the stated original masses. The algebra and reflection establish (1), including M=1. The exponential family has the exact claimed mean and masses, and its asymptotic limit proves all stated coefficient and exponent quantifiers. No counterexample or gap was found.
